primitives.name: Landmark Violation Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Violation metric** Err_lmks: ∞ if landmarks detected on only one of the pair; 0 if on neither; else **median** of per-landmark L2_MP distance (Euclidean normalized per MediaPipe model cards: shoulder distance for body, iris distance for face, wrist–middle-finger-joint distance for hands).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_1, L_2': 'sets of detected landmarks, dimensionless', 'l_i^{(1)}, l_i^{(2)}': 'landmark coordinates, normalized Euclidean units', 'Err_{lmks}': 'error metric, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Landmarks are consistently detectable across transformed inputs; normalization accounts for scale variation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Infinite error when detection asymmetry occurs; zero when both fail.

layer2.mapping: Err_lmks acts as a derived kernel for comparing pose consistency under transformation, enabling fault detection in absence of ground truth.
layer2.telemetry: Per-rule median error distribution across test images.

Each rule defines a logical constraint on pose estimator behavior. The violation metric Err_lmks quantifies deviations from expected relations, using normalized Euclidean distances.
